title: Allocator · honrar recovery_policy embebida en jobs

capability_reallocation.note: The previous owner localized the fix but could not safely mutate the existing allocator core with its available transport. Reallocation must positively satisfy both full-source patch and test runtime capabilities before claim.

semantic_identity.problem: fast allocator ignores embedded job recovery_policy when no external recovery policy file exists
acceptance: a job recovery_policy fixed_generation suppresses ordinary next-generation recovery without requiring a separate recovery-policies file
fixed-generation jobs do not reappear as ordinary recovery candidates past their fixed generation until the declared attention gate has genuinely new evidence
regression covers the jose v11 g6 to g8 misroute and existing allocator recovery tests still pass

mission: Repará el fast allocator actual para que recovery_policy embebida en un derived job participe de normalizeRecoveryPolicy cuando no exista una política externa para ese job, manteniendo precedencia explícita de la política externa. Evitá que fixed_generation/new_evidence gates vuelvan a materializar recuperación ordinaria stale.
definition_of_done: job.recovery_policy se honra cuando no existe una policy externa y la precedencia externa queda explícita y sin regresión.
José V11 con fixed_generation=6 no compila G000008 como recuperación ordinaria sin evidencia durable genuinamente nueva.
Pasan fixed_generation_recovery_filter_v1.mjs y new_evidence_gate_recovery_filter_v1.mjs más una regresión focal para policy embebida.
No se cambia autoridad CURRENT, Human Accepted, Served ni promoción.
